record.notes: The product is live and priced, so this record replaces that verdict with qualifies-with-caveat and the caveat is the card. Egress arithmetic: USD 0.02/GB x 1000 GB = USD 20 per TB, hence price_per_tb_month. The vendor quotes a monthly figure per 30 days (720 h), so 730 h is rate x 730/720: 512 MiB = 3.69 x 1.0139 = USD 3.74; 256 MiB = 2.19 x 1.0139 = USD 2.22. A persistent volume is not included; 1 GB adds USD 0.15, 10 GB adds USD 1.50. The 1 GB Machine is USD 6.70 per 30 days = USD 6.79 at 730 h, over the line. Not established: whether a debit card is accepted, and the smallest volume Fly will provision.
